svg.title: Linear drive versus rotating wave approximation
svg.desc: Same two-level Hamiltonian, initial minus-z. Probability plotted against Omega t. Weak and strong drive are compared with a converged unitary midpoint evolution; no hardware data.

g.text: Linear drive: complete model and RWA
omega = omega0 = 2 pi x 1 MHz; initial |-z>; closed two-level model
Omega / omega0 = 0.05; time window 0 to 20 us
Omega / omega0 = 0.8; time window 0 to 1.25 us
